5. alias selected more than once in one.cause: the gate splits a file on 'union all' only, so a view's last branch and its final windowed select fall in one block and each payload column, aliased once in each, reads as repeated. Parsed select by select, no alias repeats.

1. and 6. mapped column reaches no satel.cause: every such pair had ALL its map rows refused under a directive or for an unresolvable key, each registered with whose call it is.

2. src_pk / 4. hub and link key names di.cause: motor_dv_dbt names keys with the entity prefix (HUB_ASSESSMENT_HKEY, HUB_ASSESSMENT_BK, LNK_POLICY_PARTY_HKEY). partner_dv_dbt and travel_dv_dbt -- the structure this build follows by instruction -- name them ASSESSMENT_HKEY, POLICY_PARTY_HKEY, and so does this build. A convention difference, not a defect.

2. grain / src_cdk differs from the sibl.cause: data_7.js governs grain and child keys; motor_dv_dbt was built against an earlier model and an earlier map, and names child keys without the _CK suffix in places. Where data_7.js declares a satellite multi-active or declares more legs, this build follows data_7.js.
